# Security policy

This repository is T3 Code ++, a fork of [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) maintained separately from the upstream project. Report vulnerabilities in T3 Code ++ builds, releases, installers or this repository here. Reports are handled in this repository and are not forwarded upstream.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting: [report a vulnerability](https://github.com/WianVDM/t3code/security/advisories/new), also reachable from the repository's **Security** tab. The report stays private between you and the maintainer until a fix ships.

Do not open a public issue, discussion or pull request for an undisclosed vulnerability, and do not include passwords, API keys, access tokens or private keys in a report.

## What happens next

The maintainer tracks each confirmed vulnerability in a private security advisory on this repository and publishes the advisory with the fixed release. Hardening work that discloses nothing exploitable is tracked as a regular issue in this repository.

If the vulnerability is inherited from upstream T3 Code, you may also report it to upstream yourself under upstream's policy. This fork does not forward reports.

## Supported versions

Only the latest stable `vX.Y.Z-plusplus.N` release receives security fixes.
